name: @cm-workspace/deck-lib
description: Shared deck-builder core: template profiling, layout mapping, doc/PDF/pptx parsing, pptx assembly, QA. Used by both webapp/ (bundled into the published artifact) and skills/deck-builder/ (invoked via node from Python). See webapp/package.json for the same dependency set — this package.json exists only so Node module resolution works when these files run from lib/deck/ directly (the skill's cli/*.mjs entry points), and node_modules here is a symlink to webapp/node_modules rather than a second install.
